resolutions.summary: AUTH001: default-value disclosure and outbound endpoint corrections are verified; admission rejected for the remaining raw local HTTP write/trust boundary.

blockers.finding: isLocalRequest validates only Host and socket loopback (and accepts missing values). The registered raw status handler changes settings and persists UI state on GET; repair and preference handlers also rely only on this loopback check. There is no Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site or authenticated caller gate before these mutations.
blockers.requiredChange: Keep status GET read-only. Move settings changes to explicit POST JSON routes and reject wrong methods/content types. Before any private read or write, use the supported host request-trust/authentication seam, or implement equivalent Host, Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site and caller checks. Missing required request context must fail closed; loopback alone is insufficient. Apply the same gate to repair, wizard, memory and preference endpoints.
blockers.acceptance: In disposable fixtures, a loopback request marked Origin=https://untrusted.example or Sec-Fetch-Site=cross-site is rejected before reads/writes/commands. GET requests never modify settings. A trusted supported-host request still succeeds; unavailable trust service or required context rejects. No need to remove drawing, accelerator or Tool-view features.

resolutions.summary: SUPPLY001: first-party source, stable distribution metadata and web override semantics are verified; admission rejected until the actual installed runtime dependency closure is reproducible and independently reviewable.

blockers.finding: The fixed Git distribution declares five npm runtime dependencies but contains no independently verifiable, installation-enforced mapping from the actual runtime dependency closure to bounded immutable source. docs/dependency-inventory.json identifies itself as author-provided 0.2.11 metadata and lists transitive version ranges. The npm installation resolves these outside the first-party Git tree; the inventory and pnpm lock do not prove which source the DSH install path will execute.
blockers.requiredChange: Supply a reproducible runtime distribution: either include the licensed dependency runtime files in a self-contained fixed-Commit distribution, or supply a complete dependency closure with exact versions, canonical source Commits, bounded distributed-file hashes, license/install-hook evidence and a source-verifiable mechanism that makes the actual DSH install use that reviewed closure. A version list or advisory lookup alone cannot complete this gate. Normal dependencies and web provider features need not be deleted.
blockers.acceptance: The Store can independently read every runtime dependency at its immutable source, verify the complete dependency graph and source hashes within declared bounds, and bind an installation-resolution proof to this plugin Commit. All nodes have known licenses and no unreviewed install hooks; no unresolved node or floating resolution remains.
